meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Roblox's cookie bar and autoplay landing video; blur or hide game thumbnails, ratings and player counts, footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, roblox.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): cookie bar `#cookie-banner-wrapper` 1 (the original list had no rule for it, so one was added), landing video 1, game tile pictures 18, ratings and player counts 18, footer 1. The tile selectors are stable `data-testid` values from Roblox's server-driven UI (`sdui-tile-image-container`, `sdui-tile-footer-content`), not hashed classes; none depend on English text.

NOT verified: the logged-in home, game detail pages, Charts, Discover, the desktop layout, and the original ad and app-banner rules (nothing on this page matches them).
